value.message: Widened by the maintainer at the close of APS-S-41: review the whole grooming process against the S-40 and S-41 experience, not just the "plan, don't fix" rule. Lessons to work in: (1) grooming plans fixes as tasks, never edits pages; (2) show the exact text of any proposed change before writing; (3) every step's finding is presented to the maintainer, not just noted — latest inputs, health proposal, problem tree (new / sub-problems / close), and a "why does this task deserve to exist" challenge before creating or merging; (4) one kind of decision per batch; (5) plain words — no "disposition", "revise", "act/keep/merge/close". Then re-run grooming and repeat until the maintainer judges it works.
